title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: US stocks set to gain as US pressure on Iran rises and Canada trade tensions intensify - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: Wall Street futures pointed higher Tuesday as new US sanctions on Iran pushed oil prices lower, while trade tensions with Canada escalated. Nvidia earnings loom Wednesday, with investors also watching Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech and global markets.
